reason: `ModelFallback`'s default `fallback_on` adds `ModelEmptyResponseError`, which also stands for an empty response the provider ended with `finish_reason='error'`, so it falls back on one instead of the agent sending it the retry prompt, as decided on #12059 (https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/issues/12059#issuecomment-6584752558). It extends #12039's refusal fallback to provider-reported failures; `FallbackModel` and a plain `Agent` are unchanged, and `fallback_on=(ModelAPIError, ContentFilterError, OutputTokenLimitExceeded)` restores the previous default.
